description: Unfinished module the maker marks as work in progress: a mono looper that records while its control is held and can step back through earlier recordings

params.text: Records the input for as long as it is held down, and the recording plays back as a loop as soon as it is let go
Throws away the newest recording and returns to the one before it

inputs.text: Records the input for as long as it is above 0V, and the recording plays back as a loop as soon as it falls below 0V
A rising edge above 0V throws away the newest recording and returns to the one before it

outputs.text: The loop that is playing, and 0V before anything has been recorded

notes: the recording buffer holds 5,760,000 samples, two minutes at a 48kHz sample rate
every recording is written from the start of that one buffer, so stepping back to an earlier recording shortens the loop without bringing the earlier audio back
